item.title: Regulating glycerol electrooxidation pathways via catalytic environments
item.description:
Authors: Yabo Qi, Hanzhi Ye, Shouxin Liu, Hui Luo, Hongwu Chen, Maria-Magdalena Titirici

A step-resolved framework explains how catalytic environments regulate adsorption, dehydrogenation, chemical conversion, C–C cleavage and desorption to shape glycerol electrooxidation selectivity, activity and stability.

item.title: Liquid metal biomimetics: a chemical perspective
item.description:
Authors: Caiyi Liu, Jianye Gao, Yibing Ma, Jinze Li, Xiangyu Zhou, Minghui Guo, Jing Liu

A chemistry-centered framework for Ga-based liquid metal biomimetics, linking multiscale material design and interfacial reactions to matter simulation, energy conversion, information processing and cross-habitat adaptation.

item.description:
Authors: Pei Zhao, Hai-Yan Lu, Chuan-Feng Chen

Red, green and blue emitter performance is critical to full-color OLED display. This review highlights advances in RGB OLEDs based on fluorescent, phosphorescent, and TADF small-molecule emitters, with a focus on operational stability.

item.description:
Authors: Haiyang Fan, Jiaxin Li, Rui Liu, Wenxiu Yang, Xiao Feng, Bo Wang

A TPB-centered framework reveals how coupled oxygen, proton, and water transport, together with ionomer-induced interfacial effects, govern PEMFC cathode performance.

item.title: Anions as catalysts: from organosilanes as pro-nucleophiles to base-embedding electrophiles
item.description:
Authors: Alireza Abbasi Kejani, Allya Larroza, Arnaldo X. Torres-Hernandez, Paulo H. S. Paioti

Anions are efficient catalysts when combined with organosilanes as pro-nucleophiles or with base-embedding electrophiles, the latter is an emerging catalytic deprotonation strategy which disentangles turnover from acidity–basicity constraints.

item.description:
Authors: Rizwan Ur Rehman Sagar, Wei Zhang, Shaoming Huang, Ying Ian Chen

item.description:

item.description:
